title: ClimateBench2.0: Probabilistic Climate Model Scoring
testbed_rationale: ClimateBench2.0 is specifically designed as an outcome-driven probabilistic scoring benchmark framework for ranking and evaluating climate models, including ML-based emulators and hybrid ESMs, across both historical and out-of-distribution conditions.
pain_points: ESMs and climate emulators are difficult to compare in a rigorous, transparent, quantitative way
Most existing evaluations focus on specific individual processes or qualitative assessments rather than outcome predictive skill
Ensuring physical consistency (energy balance, conservation of water and carbon) during out-of-distribution predictions under strong forcings
extraction_notes: This document is a conference abstract outlining the design and motivation for the ClimateBench2.0 benchmarking framework. Concrete ML models or explicit data download links are not detailed in the abstract text.
